capabilities: Render standalone links as preview cards
Fetch page title, description, preview image and favicon
Edit, open or copy the link from the card
Show link cards on Canvas link nodes
disambiguation: Not a bookmark launcher or link dashboard; it only renders cards for links already written on their own line in notes.
extras: Fetched page data is kept in memory only and is gone when Obsidian closes; only settings are saved. No analytics or accounts. Interface in English and Russian.
intentEvidence: based on Link Card Preview by Groundfic (MIT)
problem: A bare link in a note shows no title, image or description, so readers cannot tell what it points to without opening it.

relations.evidence: based on Link Card Preview by Groundfic (MIT)

summary: Turns a standalone link line into a preview card with site image, favicon, title and description, plus edit, open and copy buttons.
